mapper.sql: id, name, domain, homepage_url, contact_name, contact_email, comment_name, intro, submit_kit::text as submit_kit, key_pages::text as key_pages, facts::text as facts, created_at, updated_at
mapper.select: select from site order by id
mapper.insert: insert into site (name, domain, homepage_url, contact_name, contact_email, comment_name, intro, submit_kit, key_pages, facts) values (#{name}, #{domain}, #{homepageUrl}, #{contactName}, #{contactEmail}, #{commentName}, #{intro}, #{submitKit}::jsonb, #{keyPages}::jsonb, #{facts}::jsonb)
mapper.update: update site set name = #{name}, domain = #{domain}, homepage_url = #{homepageUrl}, contact_name = #{contactName}, contact_email = #{contactEmail}, comment_name = #{commentName}, intro = #{intro}, submit_kit = #{submitKit}::jsonb, key_pages = #{keyPages}::jsonb, facts = #{facts}::jsonb, updated_at = now() where id = #{id}
